name: createLocationsAdvanced
description: Adds several locations at once, up to 50.

locations.description: The locations to add, up to 50 at a time.

subtitle.description: The location's subtitle. Leave it out for none.

customName.description: A name shown for the address on the map. Leave it out for none.

description.description: The location's description, as formatted text.

listImage.description: The picture shown for the location in lists, as a list holding one image.

images.description: The location's pictures, in order. Leave it out for none.

categories.description: Its categories, separated by commas, with a subcategory after an arrow, such as Food -> Pizza, Shops. Leave it out for none.

markerType.description: How the location is marked on the map. Leave it out for a pin.

markerImage.description: The picture used as the map marker, as a list holding one image. Needed when the marker type is image.

markerColor.description: The color of the circle marker, such as rgba(253,35,5,1). Leave it out for red.

showCategory.description: Whether its categories are shown. Leave it out to show them.

showOpeningHours.description: Whether its opening hours are shown. Leave it out to hide them.

showPriceRange.description: Whether its price range is shown. Leave it out to hide it.

showStarRating.description: Whether its star rating is shown. Leave it out to hide it.

priceRange.description: How pricey it is. Leave it out for the lowest.

priceCurrency.description: The currency sign shown with the price range. Leave it out for $.

mondayHours.description: Monday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out for 08:00-20:00.

tuesdayHours.description: Tuesday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out for 08:00-20:00.

wednesdayHours.description: Wednesday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out for 08:00-20:00.

thursdayHours.description: Thursday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out for 08:00-20:00.

fridayHours.description: Friday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out for 08:00-20:00.

saturdayHours.description: Saturday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out for 08:00-20:00.

sundayHours.description: Sunday's opening hours, such as 08:00-20:00, several separated by commas, or closed. Leave it out for 08:00-20:00.

actionItems.description: The location's actions, such as calling or opening a website, in order. Leave it out for none.

callback.description: Runs when all the locations are done.

error.description: Why nothing was added, such as a location missing its title.

locations.description: One result per location, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which location this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The location's id, if it was added.

error.description: Why it wasn't added, if it wasn't.
